data.name: Firmware_Flashing_Header_Alert
data.value: If you're using a Babble Tracker with Valve Index or Bigscreen Beyond (with/without 1.0 base stations), you might notice: • Your screen turns gray unexpectedly • Tracking drops or frequently loses position This is usually easy to fix! Just install the "Tracking Loss Fix" firmware below.

data.name: Home_Cameras_Linux_Workarounds
data.value: Workarounds: • Try the Steam scout 1.0 runtime (not sniper 3.0), installing libudev, building from source, or joining the plugdev group. • We only support Steam and tarball releases, not the AUR package. • Babble Boards do not support UVC/Serial on Linux, use a wireless configuration.
